definitions.explanation: Marks an extreme case, like さえ in its 'even' sense, but more written and emphatic. Almost always in negative or critical statements. After a noun with a case particle it becomes ですら, にすら.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧すら⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I don't even know the name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧ですら⟦{答|こた}えられない→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a question even experts cannot answer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れ{果|は}てて→疲れ果てる：17963_tsukarehateru⟧、⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧すら⟦{残|のこ}っていなかった→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: I was so exhausted that I didn't even have the strength left to stand up.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + すら: even N (replaces ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ and ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)
- Noun + ですら / ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すら: even N, keeping the case particle
- Noun + すら + negative: not even N

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さえ→さえ：32259_sae⟧: even; the more common word in speech, and the only one with the 'as long as' pattern (〜さえ〜ば); すら cannot be used that way
- ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: also, even; the everyday word in negatives (⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧)

REGISTER:
Written and formal speech. In conversation ⟦さえ→さえ：32259_sae⟧ or ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ sounds more natural.
